'''Aleck's Hunter Emporium''' is a shop in [[Yanille]] run by [[Aleck]], just east of the tavern. The shop sells [[Hunter]] items and is managed and owned by [[Aleck]]. It is one of four Hunter shops, the others being the [[Nardah Hunter Shop]] in [[Nardah]], [[Elder Strom's Hunting Stall]] in [[The Summer Shore]], and [[Imia's Supplies]] in the [[Hunter Guild]]. It is located conveniently close to the [[Feldip Hills|Feldip]] hunting grounds. Viewing the shop is a requirement for the [[Easy Ardougne Diary]].

Also found in the shop is [[Leon]], who sells the [[Hunters' crossbow]].
